issue_context.title: Esphome setup services broken in  PR #52348
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Since PR #52348 was merged to master, Esphome services setup is not working. 

Steps I followed:
I created a new Esphome device configuration and installed it on a physical device (in my case, NodeMCU with just 1 light configuration. Pretty simple and straightforward.)
After homeassistant notification showed up, I followed the steps to configure the device and got the following error in Logs

2021-07-20 10:53:39 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant] Error doing job: Task exception was never retrieved
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/esphome/__init__.py", line 291, in complete_setup
    await _setup_services(hass, entry_data, services)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/esphome/__init__.py", line 676, in _setup_services
    assert entry_data.device_info is not None
AssertionError

Integration has been added correctly but no devices nor services added to the integration were found.

I tracked down all the changes and found out that line 676 in file __init__.py has been added. That line is asserting that "device_info is not None" and seems to be right, however after removing the line all services are added correctly to the configuration with no issues.




### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.8.0.dev20210713

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Esphome

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/esphome/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
2021-07-20 10:53:39 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant] Error doing job: Task exception was never retrieved
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/esphome/__init__.py", line 291, in complete_setup
    await _setup_services(hass, entry_data, services)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/esphome/__init__.py", line 676, in _setup_services
    assert entry_data.device_info is not None
AssertionError
```


### Additional information

_No response_
comments:
Hmm, not sure how this can happen. Somehow the confit entry must have been added to HA, but the .storage file removed.

But this issue can be fixed by just moving the assert one line down into the loop.
It's cool man. I just enjoy very much using HA and I tried to help with this hint.

review_comments: Will we set up the services later for this device?
When the device next connects (and we have received the services data). ESPHome is a bit unique in that it has user-defined services that get transmitted by the device.
